summary: Computes a collision contact impulse term. Stores the input magnitude a3 at this+0x24 and a3 + 100.0 at this+0x20. Builds a direction vector v7 by scaling the a2 direction components (float indices 8, 9, 10) by the magnitude factor a2[1], and a delta vector v6 by subtracting the a2 position components (float indices 5, 6, 7) from three double values read at this+0xD8, this+0xE0 and this+0xE8. Returns the result of F_3DVectorCrossProductRotationAccumulation(v7, v6), the cross-product rotation accumulation term for the contact. Part of the collision response system invoked by ModeDispatchWithSwitch.

operations.description: Store the input magnitude a3 into float this+0x24.
Scale direction vector v7 = (a2[8] * a2[1], a2[9] * a2[1], a2[10] * a2[1]) using the a2 magnitude factor a2[1].
Build delta v6 = (double(this+0xD8) - a2[5], double(this+0xE0) - a2[6], double(this+0xE8) - a2[7]) between this body state and the a2 position.
Call F_3DVectorCrossProductRotationAccumulation(v7, v6) to accumulate the rotational impulse contribution.
Invoked from the frame-path caller ModeDispatchWithSwitch (0x0040F4B0).
